narr: Heavy rain from monsoon thunderstorms caused some flash flooding in Yavapai County.
ev: A trained spotter sent video and photos of Yuma Wash flooding over N. Reed Road between W Road 4.5 N and W Road 5 N.
lsr: Video and photos sent via email of flooding over N. Reed Road between W 5 N Rd and W 4.5 N Rd from Yuma Wash.
